days.title: Ancient Civilizations and Infrastructure
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Pian di Misano
stops.detail: At the beginning of the 5th century BC, the Etruscan settlement of Pian di Misano was born, which extended to the gates of today's town of Marzabotto, which was also the last flat area of a certain size before the Apennines.

stops.name: acquedotto romano
stops.detail: Dating back to around 15 BC, the Roman aqueduct is still in operation, after its nineteenth-century recovery, and continues to serve water to Bologna.

stops.name: Kainua
stops.detail: Historical route - the Etruscans: numerous remains of this ancient past, the city of Kainua with its necropolises, and other finds in various areas of the park
